sections.title: Café prices
sections.content: You know how to ask a price: *Mennyibe kerül a kávé?* The answer is the price in forints, with no verb: *A kávé háromszáz forint.* Café prices use hundreds. Put the digit before *száz* in one word: *hatszáz* (600), *nyolcszáz* (800). Add tens to the same word: *ötszázötven* (550). The noun after a number stays singular: *Két tea ötszáz forint.*

items.english: How much does the coffee cost?
How much do two coffees cost?

sections.content: A price sentence has no verb and no *-t*: *A kávé háromszáz forint*, not *forintot*. After a number the noun stays singular: *két kávé*, not *két kávék*.
